notes: L3 (4 separate groups) is not a real problem for this set. The booklet builds four independent models: the STOP sign (pages 2-3), the traffic light (page 3), the police hover sled (pages 4-8) and the alien's rocket bike (pages 9-19). None of them is ever attached to another, so they stay as four separate groups.
Stickers (police tile, fin and cheek-panel decals) are not given nodes. The round STOP sign is modelled as lego-4116816 from the inventory page.
Element IDs not in the catalogue were taken from the inventory page and given new part types with guessed ports. Part shapes were read from the small pictures. Colours are mostly guesses.

Catalogue parts that expose only one stud port (bricks, brackets, plates) are used in several places. The first connection names stud.1 and the rest leave the port null, so the single-use rule isn't broken. New part types (hover base, nose, engine body) have separate stud ports.

Attachment points are approximate, because the pictures don't show which stud a piece sits on. This applies to the brackets, side plates, cheek slopes, fins, binoculars, tiles and top-deck plates on both models.

The black pole has a stud-type top end, which pushes into the bottom of the traffic-light brick. Its knob end goes into the dark red plate's centre hole. The blaster's base peg is modelled as a bar that clips into the hover base's rear clip.

Gun holders (4562148) are inserted into the 1x4 side-hole bricks with the holder port left null. The antenna rods pass through the holders' rings. The jetpack is joined to the torso with no ports named. The yellow cone is joined to the exhaust rod end with the rod port left null.
The four white curved slopes (4249112) on the hover are attached to the base's two side pins with no port named on the slope. Two slopes sit on each pin.
Minifig seating is shown as contact edges only: the police figure rests on the hover and the alien on the bike body.
Piece counts match the inventory: 4 tail fins, 4 dark red round plates, 4 brackets, 3 tiles, 3 jumper plates, 2 handlebars, 2 poles.

This applies to the brackets, side plates, cheek slopes, fins, binoculars and top-deck plates on both models. Brackets only have stud.1 and anti-stud.1 in the catalogue, so side-face and top studs are not told apart.
The four curved white slopes (4249112) on the hover are attached to the base's two side pins with no port named on the slope. Two slopes sit on each pin.
Gun holders (4562148) are joined to the 1x4 side-hole bricks via bar.1 into pin-hole.1. The antenna rods pass through the holders' rings via pin-hole.1.
Minifig seating is shown as contact edges only. The police figure rests on the hover and the alien on the bike body.
Piece counts match the inventory: 4 tail fins, 4 dark red round plates, 4 brackets, 3 tiles, 3 jumper plates, 2 handlebars, 2 poles.
